hooks.command: if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)" = "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"MULTI-SESSION SAFETY (PawConnect): this session started in the SHARED main checkout. Multiple Claude sessions share this working tree and the checked-out branch can change at any moment. If this session will edit files or commit (implementation work), move into an isolated worktree BEFORE touching files: use the EnterWorktree tool, or relaunch via scripts/new-session.sh <issue#> <slug> (branches off develop and opens Claude Code in the worktree). Planning or read-only sessions may stay, but must re-verify the current branch before any commit. Before merging into develop or main, run scripts/check-merge-conflicts.sh and resolve reported conflicts."}}'; fi
